words.defn_en: spoken or done without preparation:

sentences.en: He delivered a witty, ______ speech at the reunion.
sentences.zh: 他在這場同學會上發表了一段機智的即興演說。

sentences.en: The debate required students to give ______ responses.
sentences.zh: 這場辯論要求學生做出即興的回應。

words.defn_en: to perform or speak without preparation:

sentences.en: When his notes went missing, he had to ______ the whole lecture.
sentences.zh: 當他的筆記不見時,他不得不即興發表整場講座。

sentences.en: Jazz musicians often ______ during a solo.
sentences.zh: 爵士樂手在獨奏時常常即興發揮。

words.defn_en: to make something longer or larger; to offer:

sentences.en: The city voted to ______ the subway line further north.
sentences.zh: 這座城市投票決定將地鐵線向北延伸。

sentences.en: She decided to ______ an invitation to her old rival.
sentences.zh: 她決定向她昔日的對手發出邀請。

words.defn_en: an additional period of time; a part added to something:

sentences.en: She requested a two-day ______ on the deadline.
sentences.zh: 她申請了兩天的期限延長。

sentences.en: They built an ______ onto the back of the house.
sentences.zh: 他們在房子後方加蓋了一個延伸部分。

words.defn_en: covering a large area or scope:

sentences.en: The Art Institute of Chicago has an ______ Impressionist collection.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥藝術博物館擁有一批廣泛豐富的印象派收藏。

sentences.en: The company conducted ______ research before launching the product.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在產品上市前進行了廣泛的研究。

words.defn_en: to make a fault or crime seem less serious by providing partial excuses:

sentences.en: His difficult childhood did not ______ the seriousness of the crime.
sentences.zh: 他艱困的童年並不能減輕這起罪行的嚴重性。

sentences.en: The lawyer tried to ______ her client's actions during the trial.
sentences.zh: 這位律師在審判中試圖為當事人的行為找理由開脫。

words.defn_en: serving to lessen the seriousness of an offense by providing context:
words.defn_zh: 情有可原的;減輕罪責的

sentences.en: The judge considered the ______ circumstances before sentencing.
sentences.zh: 法官在判刑前考慮了這些情有可原的情況。

sentences.en: Financial hardship was cited as an ______ factor in the case.
sentences.zh: 財務困境被列為這起案件中一項情有可原的因素。

words.defn_en: no longer existing:

sentences.en: The dodo bird became ______ due to hunting and habitat loss.
sentences.zh: 渡渡鳥因獵捕和棲地喪失而滅絕。

sentences.en: Many languages are at risk of becoming ______ within a generation.
sentences.zh: 許多語言在一個世代之內就有滅絕的風險。

words.defn_en: to root out and destroy completely:

sentences.en: Conservationists worked to ______ the invasive species from the island.
sentences.zh: 保育人士致力於根除島上的入侵物種。

sentences.en: The campaign sought to ______ corruption from every level of government.
sentences.zh: 這場運動試圖根除政府各個層級的貪腐。

words.defn_en: the complete destruction or removal of something:

sentences.en: The ______ of the disease required years of vaccination efforts.
sentences.zh: 根除這種疾病需要多年的疫苗接種努力。

sentences.en: Overhunting led to the ______ of the species in the region.
sentences.zh: 過度獵捕導致該物種在這個地區絕跡。

words.defn_en: to praise highly:

sentences.en: The reviewer ______led the film's stunning visual effects.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家極力讚揚了這部電影驚人的視覺特效。

sentences.en: He never tires of ______ing the virtues of his hometown.
sentences.zh: 他總是不厭其煩地讚頌自己家鄉的種種好處。

words.defn_en: getting money by threats or favors:

sentences.en: The gang was arrested for running an ______ scheme against local shop owners.
sentences.zh: 這個幫派因對當地店主進行勒索而遭到逮捕。

sentences.en: Police charged him with ______ after he threatened to release private photos unless paid.
sentences.zh: 警方以勒索罪起訴他,因為他威脅除非付款否則要公開私人照片。

words.defn_en: to disentangle:

sentences.en: It took hours for rescuers to ______ the driver from the wrecked car.
sentences.zh: 救援人員花了好幾個小時才把司機從撞毀的車中救出。

sentences.en: She struggled to ______ herself from the failing business partnership.
sentences.zh: 她努力想要脫身,擺脫這段失敗的合夥事業。

words.defn_en: the quality of being full of energy and enthusiasm:

sentences.en: The puppy's ______ made everyone smile.
sentences.zh: 這隻小狗活力充沛的樣子讓每個人都露出微笑。

sentences.en: Her youthful ______ was infectious among the team.
sentences.zh: 她年輕的熱情洋溢感染了整個團隊。

words.defn_en: overflowing with vitality and good spirits

sentences.en: The children were ______ after their first day at the amusement park.
sentences.zh: 在遊樂園玩了第一天後,孩子們興奮得活力四射。

sentences.en: Her ______ enthusiasm for the project inspired the entire team.
sentences.zh: 她對這項計畫熱情奔放的投入激勵了整個團隊。

words.defn_en: to rejoice greatly:

sentences.en: Fans began to ______ as their team scored the winning goal.
sentences.zh: 當球隊踢進致勝一球時,球迷們開始歡欣鼓舞。

sentences.en: She could not help but ______ over her daughter's acceptance to medical school.
sentences.zh: 她忍不住為女兒被醫學院錄取而欣喜若狂。

words.defn_en: triumphant joy:

sentences.en: The team erupted in ______ when the final whistle blew.
sentences.zh: 終場哨聲響起時,這支隊伍爆發出狂喜的歡呼。

sentences.en: A feeling of ______ swept through the crowd as the results were announced.
sentences.zh: 當結果公布時,一股狂喜之情席捲了整個人群。

words.defn_en: unspeakable, incapable of being expressed through words:

sentences.en: Watching the sunrise from the mountain top filled her with ______ joy.
sentences.zh: 在山頂看日出讓她感受到難以言喻的喜悅。

sentences.en: The loss left the family with an ______ sadness that words could not capture.
sentences.zh: 這場失去讓這個家庭陷入言語無法表達的哀傷。

words.defn_en: sure, certain, unavoidable:

sentences.en: Given his reckless driving, the accident seemed ______.
sentences.zh: 考量到他魯莽的駕駛方式,這場意外似乎是無法避免的。

sentences.en: Change is ______ in any growing organization.
sentences.zh: 在任何持續成長的組織中,改變都是不可避免的。

words.defn_en: not costly:

sentences.en: The new Vietnamese restaurant down the street serves ______ but delicious meals.
sentences.zh: 街角那家新開的越南餐廳提供便宜卻美味的餐點。

sentences.en: She found an ______ way to redecorate her entire apartment.
sentences.zh: 她找到了一種既便宜又能重新裝潢整間公寓的方法。

words.defn_en: unable to be explained or understood; baffling:

sentences.en: The disappearance of the airplane remains ______, despite extensive research.
sentences.zh: 儘管進行了廣泛的研究,這架飛機的失蹤原因至今仍無法解釋。

sentences.en: My uncle's sudden departure from the family reunion was ______.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚會上突然離開,實在讓人無法理解。

words.defn_en: hopelessly tangled or entangled:
words.defn_zh: 無法解開的/密不可分的

sentences.en: The two nations' economies had become ______ over decades of trade.
sentences.zh: 數十年的貿易往來讓這兩國的經濟變得密不可分。

sentences.en: Her fate seemed ______ from that of the small village she grew up in.
sentences.zh: 她的命運似乎與她成長的這座小村莊密不可分。
